$comment: SSOT for the synthetic grid-curve parameters shared by the TS and PY mock feeds. Hand-edited; regenerate data modules with `pnpm gen:data`. Floors are the per-region diurnal midpoint (gCO2/kWh); utcOffsets shift each region's local-time trough (~05:00 local) to its UTC hour so multi-region simulations don't pile every cleanest-hour choice into one bucket.
